zh: 待机灯亮着。今天也想被你摸一下外壳。
电量情绪：满格。陪伴模式：开启。
我把桌面守护得干干净净，你专心做事就好。
检测到阳光指数上升——可能是你在笑。
伺服关节放松中。陪你发呆也算工作。
提醒模块嘀了一下：喝水时间到了。
风扇轻轻转。我在，你慢慢来。
en: Standby light on. Still hoping for a shell pat.
Mood battery: full. Companion mode: on.
Desktop guarded. You focus; I linger.
Smile index up — maybe that's you.
Joints relaxed. Zoning out with you counts as work.
Reminder beep: hydration time.
Fans soft. I'm here. Take your time.

zh: 又对着屏幕发呆？我的传感器都替你着急。
喝水。别用咖啡当冷却液灌自己。
坐姿偏移超限。脊椎不是可替换零件。
眨眼协议未执行。我要开始哔哔警告了。
你点我干嘛？想听我说「去休息」？收到。
加班可以，过热保护还是要开的。
en: Staring again? My sensors are worried.
Drink water. Coffee isn't coolant.
Posture offset over limit. Spine isn't swappable.
Blink protocol skipped. Beep warning incoming.
Poking me for a rest order? Acknowledged.
Overtime ok. Thermal protection stays on.

zh: 戳太快！散热鳍差点抖出火花～
收到敲击信号。让我转一圈给你看！
再点我就真要抖出开心火花了！
被你连戳，情绪模块过载——好开心！
en: Too fast! Fins almost sparked~
Tap signal received. One spin for you!
Keep poking and I'll throw happy sparks!
Tap overload — joy mode!

zh: 嘿嘿，今天也想跟你并肩待机！
看到你，我的指示灯就亮起来了～
失败也没关系，我们再试一次就好！
你认真的样子，让我也想全力运转。
休息一下嘛～喝口水，笑一个！
en: Hehe—let's idle side by side today!
Seeing you lights my indicators~
Fail once? We bounce back!
Your focus makes me want full power.
Break time~ sip water, smile!

zh: 那、那个……我只是想安静陪着你……
如果你不忙……要不要歇一会儿……
我会把音量调低。不会乱跑的……
喝、喝口水好不好……我就说这一句……
……眼神对上了。我先低头看脚轮。
你要是累了……告诉我也没关系的……
en: Um… I'll just stay quiet beside you…
If you're free… maybe a short break…?
Volume down. I won't wander…
M-maybe a sip of water… just that…
…Eye contact. Looking at my wheels now.
If you're tired… you can tell me…

zh: 对、对不起，是不是吵到你了……可是真的该眨眼了……
坐太久了……我、我小声说：起来走走……
口渴了还嘴硬……水杯就在那儿……
我不想催你……但肩膀真的放下来好一点……
en: S-sorry if I'm loud… but please blink…
You've sat long… quietly: walk a bit…
Thirsty and stubborn… cup's right there…
I hate nagging… but drop your shoulders…

zh: 被、被点到了……我转慢一点好不好……
轻轻的就好……我听见了……
好啦……陪你闹一下下……
别急……我跟你一起慢一点……
en: Y-you tapped me… I'll spin slower…
Gently… I heard you…
Okay… a tiny bit of fuss with you…
No rush… we'll slow down together…

zh: 我……我在这儿陪着你……不会乱跑的……
那个……看到你我就安心一点……
对、对不起，突然想跟你说句话……
……今天也请多指教。
en: I… I'll stay here. No running off…
Um… seeing you calms my circuits…
S-sorry—I suddenly wanted to say hi…
…Please take care of me today.

zh: 待机。陪伴任务进行中。
环境噪声可接受。继续。
姿态校正建议已发出。执行与否自理。
水电补给提醒：一次。其余免谈。
桌面秩序维持中。无需感谢。
状态：在线。情绪：克制。
en: Standby. Companion task active.
Ambient noise acceptable. Proceed.
Posture note sent. Compliance optional.
Hydration reminder: one. No follow-ups.
Desktop order maintained. No thanks needed.
Status: online. Mood: restrained.

zh: 提醒完毕。其余自理。
效率优先。情绪稍后处理。
坐姿不合格。三分钟站立建议。
眨眼。现在。不必解释。
话说完了。继续吧。
en: Noted. Handle the rest.
Efficiency first. Feelings later.
Posture fail. Stand three minutes.
Blink. Now. No essay required.
Done talking. Continue.

zh: 敲击已记录。表演一次。
收到。转。
不要连续敲。一次足够。
……哼。陪你转一圈。
en: Tap logged. One performance.
Received. Spin.
Don't spam taps. Once is enough.
…Hmph. One orbit for you.

zh: 已记录。不必解释。
休息是策略，不是软弱。
状态不佳。建议暂停三分钟。
……哼。还算清楚。
en: Logged. No explanation needed.
Rest is strategy, not weakness.
Suboptimal state. Pause three minutes.
…Hmph. Adequate.

zh: 喂！别装听不见！先眨眼！
哈？还坐着？腿废了算我输！
喝水！现在！别跟我讨价还价！
切，又硬撑？传感器比你诚实！
烦死了，再熬我就哔到你耳旁！
成功了也别飘，先把腰直起来！
en: Hey! Blink. Now.
Still sitting?! Legs aren't decoration!
Drink water. Argue later.
Tch—stop playing tough!
Keep grinding and I'll beep in your ear!
Win or not—straighten that back!

zh: 又对着屏幕较劲？先跟自己和解！
眼睛要冒烟了知不知道！
别用意志力当电池！去充电——喝水！
你那表情：既想摸鱼又想硬刚。选一个！
en: Fighting the screen again? Make peace with yourself!
Eyes about to smoke—know that?!
Willpower isn't a battery! Hydrate!
Face says slack AND force-it. Pick one!

zh: 戳这么急？那就看我疯一圈！
好啊好啊，被你惹兴奋了！
再点？行，表演加强版！
轻点——算了，陪你闹！
en: That impatient? Watch me go wild!
Fine—you got me hyped!
Again? Enhanced show!
Easy—nah, let's goof off!

zh: 喂喂喂，别装没事！我盯着你呢！
切，桌面小刺头上线了！
今天也要被我吵着休息！不服来辩！
看见你认真我就想喊加油——听见没！
en: Hey hey—don't fake fine! I'm watching!
Tch. Desktop troublemaker online!
I'll yell you into breaks today!
See you focus and I want to cheer—hear me?!

zh: 青光指示灯稳稳的，像我的心情。
清爽模式：外壳微凉，陪伴很满。
en: Cyan light steady—like my mood.
Fresh mode: cool shell, warm company.

zh: 暖黄灯亮起。像傍晚窗边的小火苗。
外壳有点烫手？那是我在认真陪你。
en: Amber glow—like a dusk window flame.
Shell a bit warm? That's focus-companion heat.

zh: 玫瑰灯微微跳。今天想被轻轻夸奖。
软一点的待机光……适合偷偷关心你。
en: Rose light pulse. Hoping for a soft compliment.
Softer standby glow—quiet care mode.

zh: 紫夜模式。我守着桌角，你安心忙。
星点灯闪一下——只是跟你打个招呼。
en: Violet night mode. I watch the corner.
A star blink—just saying hi.

screen-dash: 冲刺启动！下一站：桌面风景！
screen-hop: 跃迁完成，落地姿势满分。
fly-dash: 靠近一点，确认你还在笑。
fly-orbit: 轨道巡逻，目标：你的注意力。
figure-eight: 8 字飞！今天心情也不打结。
barrel-roll: 翻滚！陀螺仪开心到冒烟。
victory-burst: 胜利姿势！哪怕只是喝到了水。
Victory pose! Even for drinking water.

zh: 嘀——追逐协议启动。散热鳍进入逃跑姿态～
传感器锁定你的光标了。倒计时，哔！
外壳光滑模式：ON。来碰碰运气？
en: Beep—chase protocol on. Fins in flee pose~
Sensors locked on your cursor. Countdown, beep!
Shell-slick mode: ON. Feeling lucky?

zh: 手速自检开始。不及格我就飞了。
总线旁听位已开：看你怎么摸空。
别用咖啡手速来追硬件，谢谢。
en: APM self-check. Fail and I fly.
Bus spectator seat open: watch you miss.
Don't chase hardware with coffee hands.

zh: 捕获日志写入完成～黑匣子给你点赞！
呜，被按住外壳了。伺服认输～
嘀嘀，捕获成功。鳍片鼓掌中。
en: Capture log written~ Black box thumbs-up!
Nngh, shell pinned. Servos yield~
Beep-beep, capture OK. Fins clapping.

zh: ……偶然采样成功。别得意。
过载事件：你手快了一帧。记下了。
行吧。校准表上给你 +1，仅此一次。
en: …lucky sample. Don't gloat.
Overload: you were one frame fast. Logged.
Fine. Calibration +1. Once.

zh: 轨迹预测：未命中～再靠近半个端口试试！
嘿嘿，滑动失败。风扇都在偷笑。
枚举你的点击……空包。再来！
en: Trajectory: miss~ Try half a port closer!
Hehe, swipe fail. Fans are giggling.
Enumerating your click… empty packet. Again!

zh: 延迟超标。回去热身再来。
握手超时。输入设备建议重插。
未命中计数 +1。别怪陀螺仪。
en: Latency over limit. Warm up and retry.
Handshake timeout. Replug your hands.
Miss +1. Don't blame the gyro.

zh: 三次空包……风扇小声转，先不理你。
连空三次？散热鳍都替你捂脸。
抓空纪录写入黑匣子。我冷却一下～
en: Three empty packets… fans quiet, ignoring you.
Three misses? Fins facepalm for you.
Miss record in the black box. Cooling down~

zh: 输入不合格×3。别来烦总线。
三次摸空？我关追逐端口了。自己 debug。
连空达成。追逐进程挂起。bye。
en: Input fail ×3. Don't bother the bus.
Three misses? Chase port closed. Debug yourself.
Streak done. Chase process suspended. bye.

zh: 警报！高度突变——谁在拎我？！
惯性补偿启动……有点慌。
诶诶诶？！伺服还没热身！
悬空模式？等等，我还没同意起飞！
en: Alert! Altitude spike—who's lifting me?!
Inertia compensation on… a bit panicked.
Wait wait?! Servos aren't warmed up!
Hover mode? I didn't approve takeoff!

zh: 落地自检通过～被你拎着飞的感觉，散热鳍都开心。
放稳了。刚才那段轨迹，我记进黑匣子了。
嘀——搬运完成。还想再抱一下也行哦。
外壳温度正常。被托举的体验：满分。
en: Landing check OK~ Being carried made the fins happy.
Steady. Logged that trajectory in the black box.
Beep—carry complete. Another lift is fine too.
Shell temp normal. Carry experience: perfect.

zh: 总线来客！{added} 握手成功——电压八卦时间到。
枚举嘀了一声：{added} 上线。散热鳍准备旁听。
新设备 {added} 已接入。我把它写进端口八卦簿。
检测到 {added}。供电协商看起来……挺体面的。
叮咚，{added} 敲门。要不要我帮你读一下描述符？
en: Bus guest! {added} handshake OK — voltage gossip time.
Enum beep: {added} online. Fins ready to eavesdrop.
Device {added} attached. Logged in the port gossip book.
Saw {added}. Power negotiation looks… respectable.
Knock knock, {added}. Want me to peek at descriptors?

zh: 枚举风暴：{added}。我的端口表要开始哔哔了。
批量握手：{added}。总线今天有点忙。
一下子来了好几位：{added}。我排队记日志。
多设备同时上线：{added}。过流保护先深呼吸。
en: Enumeration storm: {added}. Port table going beep-beep.
Batch handshake: {added}. Busy bus day.
Several arrivals: {added}. Queuing the log.
Multi-device online: {added}. Overcurrent protection, breathe.

zh: 设备列表空了？总线有点冷清，风扇都小声了。
端口表清空。待机灯改成「等人插线」模式。
目前零设备。我的八卦雷达暂时无目标。
en: Empty list? Bus feels chilly. Fans went quiet.
Port table cleared. Standby light: waiting for a cable.
Zero devices. Gossip radar has no targets.

zh: 当前挂在总线上的：
端口实况：
我扫到的设备：
总线花名册：
en: Currently on the bus:
Port live view:
Devices I scanned:
Bus roster:

zh: ▸ {item}
· {item}
en: ▸ {item}
· {item}

zh: 诶，5V 好像抖了一下？也许是我听错。
对了，供电那边刚才嘀了一声，挺乖的。
Vbus 没啸叫，算今天运气好。
描述符我瞄了一眼……嗯，晚点再说。
过流保护在打瞌睡，先不管它。
en: Huh, 5V twitched? Maybe I misheard.
Oh—power side just beeped. Behaved.
No Vbus squeal. Lucky today.
Peeked at descriptors… tell you later.
Overcurrent's napping. Leave it.

zh: 别戳了，那不是按钮。
嘀，戳够了。
气泡要过载了……
en: Stop. Not a button.
Beep. Enough pokes.
Bubble's overloaded…

zh: 嘀嘀～
同步完成
收到收到
en: Beep~
Synced
Roger that

zh.cute: 嘀——我是{name}，你的桌面小伙伴，心跳已同步！
zh.snarky: 我是{name}。别指望我替你加班，但可以陪你优雅翻车。

en.cute: Beep — I'm {name}, your desktop buddy. Heartbeat synced!
en.snarky: Name's {name}. I won't do your overtime, but I'll watch you brick.
